subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers clear or adopt the open dirty fork PR and allow a fresh current-main repair for this Debug Snapshots issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but an open fork PR still closes this issue while targeting obsolete files and reporting a dirty merge state.

options.title: Clear fork PR and queue fresh fix
options.body: Treat the open fork PR as stale or unviable, then allow a narrow current-main fix with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt or wait for the fork PR
options.body: Keep this issue blocked until a maintainer or the fork author rebases and updates that implementation for the current Debug page split.

recommendation.title: Clear fork PR and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Treat the open fork PR as stale or unviable, then allow a narrow current-main fix with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Debug dashboard surface and is the strongest routing candidate for deciding whether to clear the stale external fix path.
